name: Fixture Cyclical Operations
description: Exercises cyclical state models and looping patterns: a concern whose states recur after a one-time setup prefix, driven by a pattern whose phases repeat.

alphas.name: Service Health
alphas.description: Whether a running service is behaving as the people depending on it expect.

states.name: Instrumented
states.description: Signals exist that would reveal the service misbehaving.

checklist.name: Signals emitted
checklist.description: The service emits the signals its health is judged by.

states.name: Healthy
states.description: The service is behaving within its agreed bounds.

checklist.name: Within bounds
checklist.description: Every health signal sits inside its agreed threshold.

states.name: Degraded
states.description: The service is outside its agreed bounds and someone knows.

checklist.name: Breach acknowledged
checklist.description: The breach is acknowledged by someone able to act on it.

states.name: Recovering
states.description: A corrective action is in flight and its effect is being watched.

checklist.name: Action in flight
checklist.description: A corrective action has been taken and its effect is being measured.

loopsBackTo.description: Recovery returns the service to health, and the cycle runs again for the next incident.

condition.name: Recovery confirmed
given: a corrective action has been applied
when: the health signals return within their thresholds
then: the service is considered healthy again and watched for the next breach
condition.description: Whether the corrective action restored the service, deciding if the cycle runs again.

patterns.name: Operate and Recover
patterns.description: The repeating loop of running a service and restoring it when it slips.

patternViews.name: Instrument
patternViews.description: Make the service observable before relying on it.

patternViews.name: Run
patternViews.description: Operate the service within its agreed bounds.

patternViews.name: Respond
patternViews.description: Act on a breach and confirm the service recovers.

loopsBackTo.description: Each incident returns the service to normal running.

condition.name: Service restored
given: a breach has been responded to
when: the service returns within its thresholds
then: the team resumes normal running until the next breach
condition.description: Whether the service is back within its thresholds, deciding if normal running resumes.
